transformations.rationale: The Rust method receiver `self` is represented as the explicit Verus parameter `slice`; the public target remains executable and carries the generated permutation and sorted-by-Ord contract.

The recursive/private unstable-sort implementation behind `sort::unstable::sort` is isolated as a named source-backed helper boundary. The public target function is executable and not `external_body`.

The Rust 1.96 body passes `&mut T::lt` to the unstable sorter. The harness preserves that call shape and records the Ord comparison relation through existing generated vocabulary instead of adding stability or unique-output obligations.
